sections.heading: Receptor & GPCR Discovery: Opiate Receptors, Second Messengers & Nitric Oxide

episodes.label: The Calabar Bean & the Missing Signal — Physostigmine, Acetylcholinesterase Ser203 Carbamylation, Antimuscarinic Delirium & QRS Counterfactuals
episodes.notes: From Efik esere ordeal records in Old Calabar and Thomas Richard Fraser's Edinburgh experiments to human acetylcholinesterase Ser203 carbamylation (4EY4/1GQR), false-positive urine TCA immunoassays, and ECG QRS gating in antimuscarinic delirium.

episodes.label: The Mirror-Image Test for an Opioid Receptor — Goldstein's Stereospecificity, Pert & Snyder's [3H]Naloxone Levorphanol vs. Dextrorphan Assay & Enkephalin Discovery
episodes.notes: Biochemical proof of brain opioid receptors: Goldstein et al. (1971) enantiomeric competition concept, Pert & Snyder (1973) [3H]naloxone vacuum-filtration assay showing stereospecific displacement by (-)-levorphanol but not (+)-dextrorphan, Hughes et al. (1975) discovery of endogenous pentapeptides Met- and Leu-enkephalin, and 1992 delta-receptor cloning.

sections.heading: Precision Oncology, Radioligands & Metabolic Cancer Traps

episodes.label: One Ångström from a Dividing Cell — Paclitaxel in the β-Tubulin Taxane Pocket (1JFF), Cremophor Anaphylaxis & Mitotic Spindle Fate
episodes.notes: Atomic-scale journey into the luminal beta-tubulin taxane pocket (PDB 1JFF): distinguishing Cremophor EL complement-mediated infusion anaphylaxis from delayed neutropenia, M-loop lateral protofilament stabilization, and multipolar mitotic spindle catastrophe in human tumors.

Lithium and the Level That Came Back — Cade & Schou, Lithium-Heparin Tube Artifacts, GSK-3β Mg2+ Competition, ENaC Nephrogenic DI & Post-Dialysis Rebound
episodes.notes: Clinical and molecular dissection of lithium toxicity: lithium-heparin green-top collection tube false elevations (Wills et al.), GSK-3β and IMPase Mg2+ competition (PDB 1PYX, 2BJI), collecting-duct ENaC entry (PDB 6BQN) and AQP2 downregulation, and EXTRIP hemodialysis rebound kinetics.

episodes.label: Foxglove, Digoxin & the Number That Rose After Rescue — Withering's Dropsy, Na+/K+-ATPase 4RET, DigiFab Immunoassay Interference & Free vs. Total LC-MS/MS
episodes.notes: From William Withering's 1785 dropsy cases to the 4 A porcine Na+/K+-ATPase crystal structure (4RET), UHPLC-MS/MS MRM transitions, and why ovine DigiFab rescue causes total serum digoxin immunoassays to surge twelvefold while free pharmacologically active digoxin plummets.

episodes.label: The Lactate That Wasn't There — Ethylene Glycol Poisoning, Point-of-Care Glycolate Oxidase Cross-Reactivity & True Lab Lactate
episodes.notes: Behind the Curtain forensic & clinical toxicology analysis of ethylene glycol poisoning: why blood-gas point-of-care L-lactate oxidase electrodes misread glycolate as massive hyperlactatemia while core-lab assays reveal the true lactate gap (Hauvik et al. 2018).

episodes.label: What the Bottle Could Not Tell — Postmortem Toxicology Redistribution, Pill-Bottle Scene Priors vs. Femoral Blood Quantification & Tolerance Boundaries
episodes.notes: Forensic toxicology investigation of why pill bottles and scene containers cannot establish cause of death alone: postmortem central-to-peripheral redistribution, femoral vs. cardiac blood sampling, quantitative LC-MS/MS confirmation, and acquired opioid/sedative tolerance.

episodes.label: The Drug Behind the Result — Lisdexamfetamine Prodrugs, Chiral d/l-Amphetamine LC-MS/MS & Matrix Stability
episodes.notes: Behind the Curtain Evidence Ledger & Longform Analysis (The Drug Behind the Result): specimen-bound diagnostic mechanics, assay boundaries, and real clinical/forensic case studies.

sections.heading: Everyday Patient Drug Safety, Maternal-Infant Risk & Bans

episodes.label: The Pump at the Brain — Blood-Brain Barrier P-Glycoprotein (ABCB1) Efflux, Loperamide vs. Fentanyl CNS Exclusion, Cryo-EM ATPase Cycle & Drug-Drug Interactions
episodes.notes: Behind the Curtain Pharmacology deep dive into blood-brain barrier ABCB1 (P-glycoprotein) efflux: why potent mu-opioid agonists like loperamide act peripherally unless P-gp is overwhelmed or inhibited, inward-to-outward cryo-EM peristaltic extrusion, and clinical transporter inhibition.

episodes.label: The First Calories Back — Refeeding Syndrome, Insulin-Driven Phosphate/Potassium Shifts, PDH E1 ThDP Geometry (1NI4) & Doig ICU Trial
episodes.notes: From starvation to refeeding syndrome in the ICU: insulin-stimulated Na+/K+-ATPase potassium uptake and intracellular phosphate trapping, human pyruvate dehydrogenase E1 thiamine diphosphate (ThDP) active-site geometry (PDB 1NI4), whole-blood ThDP LC-MS/MS assays, diaphragmatic weakness in hypophosphatemia (Aubier 1985), and the Doig et al. (2015) caloric restriction trial.

episodes.label: Warfarin & the Three Clocks of Bleeding — Spoiled Sweet Clover, VKORC1 Asn80/Tyr139, Chiral S/R-Warfarin m/z 307→161, 4F-PCC vs. INR & Serial ICH CT
episodes.notes: From spoiled sweet-clover hemorrhagic disease and Link's 1947 patent to human VKORC1 Asn80/Tyr139 crystal contacts, chiral LC-MS/MS separation of S- and R-warfarin (sharing m/z 307->161), and separating the three clinical clocks of drug clearance, factor replacement (4F-PCC vs. plasma), and intracerebral hematoma expansion.

episodes.label: The Blue Dye & the Oxygen Number — Methylene Blue, Acquired Methemoglobinemia, Two-Wavelength SpO2 vs. Co-Oximetry & G6PD Limits
episodes.notes: How an industrial phenothiazine dye became the antidote for acquired methemoglobinemia—and why both ferric methemoglobin (660/940 nm) and intravenous methylene blue itself spoof two-wavelength pulse oximeters toward an ~85% plateau while multiwavelength co-oximetry separates fractional species.
